validationResults.name: Round-trip conversion with full learning metrics
validationResults.description: Validates that templates with complete learning metrics are correctly converted through toCanonical → fromCanonical → toCanonical cycle

validationResults.name: Missing metrics fields use defaults
validationResults.description: Validates that templates without estimated_metrics field use defensive defaults (all metrics → 0)

validationResults.name: Partial metrics with null-coalescing
validationResults.description: Validates that templates with partial estimated_metrics use null-coalescing (present fields preserved, missing → 0)

learningDataIntegrity.description: All learning metrics (executions, successRate, avgDuration, avgCost) correctly extracted from estimated_metrics and preserved through conversion

roundTripConversion.description: Learning data preserved through toCanonical → fromCanonical → toCanonical cycle

intentionalInformationLoss.description: avgTokens correctly hardcoded to zeros (backend limitation), version and genealogy regenerated (intentional design)

defensiveDefaults.description: Missing or partial metrics use null-coalescing to default values (0)

retrievableWithCompleteSchema.evidence: ActivitySchemaAdapter.toCanonical successfully extracts all learning fields from estimated_metrics

noInformationLossForLearning.evidence: executions, successRate, avgDuration, avgCost preserved. avgTokens=zeros is intentional backend limitation.

noClientSideConversionErrors.evidence: Defensive defaults prevent runtime errors. Malformed/missing data handled gracefully with null-coalescing.

bidirectionalConversion.evidence: Round-trip loses avgTokens (reset to zeros), version and genealogy (regenerated). Documented as design decision.

conclusion.message: All validation tests passed. Specification is satisfied.
evidence: Learning data integrity verified (executions, successRate, avgDuration, avgCost)
Intentional information loss documented and verified (avgTokens, version, genealogy)
Defensive defaults work correctly for missing/partial data
recommendations: Continue using validation harness for regression testing
Run harness after any changes to ActivitySchemaAdapter or BootstrapTemplates
Consider expanding test coverage for edge cases (very large metrics, negative values, etc.)
